description.from:
After routing decision and certificates: Route 53 A/AAAA alias records from chattic.us (and env subdomains) to the web distribution; API hostname to the matching thin-turn distribution if using a subdomain.

Update python/src/chatticus/cloud_environments.py pinned URLs only as fallbacks; prefer SSM discovery.

Verify HTTPS redirect and that SSE reconnect (Last-Event-ID) works through the chosen path — exercise with scripts/exercise_thin_turn.py or a browser acceptance check.
description.to:
Route 53 alias records: chattic.us (prod), staging.chattic.us, dev.chattic.us -> the unified web CloudFront distribution (same origin serves UI and /api/*).

Single ACM cert per hostname (or SAN cert). No api.chattic.us subdomain.

Verify: HTTPS, Next.js loads, POST /api/channels/... works, GET /api/turns/{id}/stream SSE reconnect with Last-Event-ID through the /api path.

Update cloud_environments.py fallbacks and acceptance workflow secrets to site-url not separate API URL.
